details: Developed Java 17 and Spring Boot microservices supporting healthcare claims processing and policy underwriting workflows, ensuring high system availability and reliable error recovery.
Developed Kafka producers and consumers for asynchronous communication between backend services, implementing schema validation, message serialization, and dead-letter queue error handling.
Contributed to distributed workflow implementation across billing and policy services using Kafka event-driven messaging and compensatory retry handling.
Optimized Elasticsearch queries, index mappings, and analyzer configurations for policy lookup, improving search response times from ~450ms to sub-150ms.
Optimized relational database queries, table indexing, and supported MySQL/Oracle primary-replica configurations with Redis caching to reduce query latency and database load.
Integrated Jenkins CI/CD deployment pipelines with automated CodeQL static analysis and SonarQube quality gates to enforce code quality standards and prevent defect escapes.
Developed backend RESTful microservices for automated portfolio rebalancing workflows within a wealth management platform supporting over $500M in assets under management (AUM).
Engineered secure, idempotent REST APIs to integrate internal portfolio workflows with external banking gateways and third-party financial settlement networks.
Optimized Spring Data JPA queries, database indexing, and Hibernate configurations for end-of-day batch settlement processing, reducing execution times by ~35%.
Mentored junior engineers through technical design discussions and peer code reviews, helping improve code quality and maintainability.
Developed backend REST APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and Spring Data JPA for an order processing and shipment tracking platform handling up to 200K+ daily orders.
Implemented State and Strategy design patterns to manage multi-stage shipment lifecycles, ensuring clean status transitions and business rule validation.
Optimized database queries and HikariCP connection pool configurations, reducing API latency during peak shipment processing windows.
Developed core Java application modules, data transformation utilities, and scheduled batch jobs supporting public assistance case management systems.
Authored automated unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito, ensuring reliable test coverage and resolving production defect tickets ahead of SLA deadlines.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment to participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and root cause analysis (RCA) for client-reported issues.
